tools.name: ros2_action_request_result
tools.description: Wait for the RESULT of a ROS 2 action (GetResult) for a given goal_id. Before **every** use of this tool, the agent should ensure the target action exists (e.g., by calling 'ros2_list_actions').

goal_id_hex.description: 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes).

timeout_sec.description: Seconds to wait for GetResult; null → wait indefinitely.

wait_for_service_sec.description: Seconds to wait for the GetResult service to appear.

tools.name: ros2_action_subscribe_feedback
tools.description: Subscribe to feedback messages of a ROS 2 action. Optionally filter by goal_id_hex. Collects feedback for a fixed duration or until a maximum number of messages is received. Each message contains goal_id, feedback payload, and receive timestamp.

duration_sec.description: How many seconds to keep spinning and collecting feedback.

goal_id_hex.description: Optional 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes) to filter feedbacks.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of feedback messages to collect.

tools.name: ros2_action_subscribe_status
tools.description: Subscribe to '/<action>/_action/status' (action_msgs/msg/GoalStatusArray) and return a snapshot of status frames over a time window. Each frame contains goal_id, accept_stamp, status_code and status text.

duration_sec.description: How many seconds to collect status frames.

max_messages.description: Max number of individual statuses to collect in total.

tools.name: ros2_cancel_action_goal
tools.description: Cancel a ROS 2 action goal via '/<action>/cancel_goal' (action_msgs/srv/CancelGoal). You can cancel a specific goal by goal_id_hex or cancel all matching goals using cancel_all=True. Optionally limit cancellation to goals accepted before a given stamp (sec/nanosec). Before **every** use of this tool, the agent should ensure the target action exists (e.g., by calling 'ros2_list_actions').

cancel_all.description: If true, send zero-UUID to cancel all matching goals.

goal_id_hex.description: 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes). Omit when cancel_all=True.

stamp_nanosec.description: Nanoseconds part for the acceptance time filter.

stamp_sec.description: Cancel goals accepted BEFORE this sec (default 0 → usually all).

wait_timeout_sec.description: Timeout (seconds) to wait for the service and response.

tools.name: ros2_get_message_fields
tools.description: Returns the fields of a given ROS2 message type.

message_type.description: Full ROS2 message type, e.g., std_msgs/msg/String

tools.name: ros2_get_messages_stored_in_influx_data_base
tools.description:
Calls the ROS2 ‘/get_messages’ service to retrieve past messages from a topic for data which is stored in InfluxDB.
            Check if the /get_messages service is available before calling.

message_type.description: Full ROS2 message type used for decoding

time_end.description: ISO8601 timestamp string to filter messages before a point in time.

time_start.description: ISO8601 timestamp string to filter messages after a point in time.

topic_name.description: Name of the topic to retrieve messages from.

tools.name: ros2_interface_list
tools.description: Returns a list of available ROS 2 interfaces.

tools.name: ros2_list_actions
tools.description:
List all available ROS 2 actions with their types and request fields.
            This tool queries the current ROS graph to discover active action servers and
            returns a structured description for each action.

tools.name: ros2_send_action_goal
tools.description: Send a goal to a ROS 2 action by name and action type using provided goal fields. Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_list_actions' and 'ros2_interface_list' to ensure the latest available actions and types are known. Optionally wait for the result with a timeout.

goal_fields.description: Dictionary with goal message fields (1st section of .action file)

timeout_sec.description: Timeout (seconds) for waiting on the result when wait_for_result=true

wait_for_result.description: If true, wait for GetResult and include final status/result

tools.name: ros2_service_call
tools.description:
Call a ROS 2 service by name and type using provided fields.
            Will ask the user to confirm if some fields are missing unless 'force_call' is set to True.
            Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2 service list' and 'ros2 interface list' to ensure the latest interface information is available.

fields.description: Dictionary of fields to send in the service request.

force_call.description: Whether to call the service even if some fields are missing

service_name.description: Name of the service to call

service_type.description: Full ROS 2 service type, before pass, check service type using tool ros2_service_list

tools.name: ros2_service_list
tools.description: Returns a list of available ROS 2 services and their request fields.

tools.name: ros2_stream_next
tools.description: Fetch the latest item from a stream session. If after_seq is provided, returns available=false until seq increases. UI/App-only tool.

tools.name: ros2_stream_next_image
tools.description: Fetch the latest image from an image stream session and return it as ImageContent (useful when the client cannot render the Viewer App UI). UI/App-only tool.

tools.name: ros2_stream_start
tools.description: Start a keep-latest stream session for a ROS 2 topic (Image/CompressedImage/PointCloud2/Generic). Returns a session_id. UI/App-only tool.

max_points.description: Max points to return; <=0 means no limit.

qos_preset.description: QoS preset for the stream subscription. Use sensor_data for most camera topics.

target_fps.description: Soft cap for processing frames (keep-latest, drops when over).

tools.name: ros2_stream_stop
tools.description: Stop and clean up a stream session previously started with ros2_stream_start. UI/App-only tool.

tools.name: ros2_topic_list
tools.description: Returns a list of available ROS 2 topics and their types.

tools.name: ros2_topic_publish
tools.description:
Publish a message to a ROS 2 topic by name and message type using provided field values.
            Supports single publish (default) or continuous publishing at a specified frequency for a duration.
            Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_topic_list' and 'ros2_interface_list'
            to ensure the latest available topics and message types are known.

data.description: Dictionary containing the message fields and values

duration.description: Optional: Duration in seconds for continuous publishing. Must be used with frequency parameter.

frequency.description: Optional: Publish frequency in Hz (messages per second). If provided with duration, publishes repeatedly.

topic_name.description: Name of the topic to publish to

tools.name: ros2_topic_subscribe
tools.description:
Subscribe to a ROS 2 topic by name collecting messages for a given time or count limit.
            Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_topic_list'
            to ensure it has the latest available topics

duration.description: If provided, collects messages for this many seconds.

message_limit.description: If provided, stops after receiving this number of messages.

topic_name.description: Name of the topic to subscribe to

tools.name: ros2_viewer_app
tools.description: Open an interactive ROS 2 viewer app (Image + PointCloud2 + Plot) for MCP clients that support Apps/HTML resources.

plot_fields.description: Optional list of plot field paths to preselect in Plot mode.

tools.name: ros2_viewer_config
tools.description: Return the last ROS 2 Viewer App configuration (if any). UI/App-only tool.
